_about: Addresses for an injected DLL, as image VAs at the PC image base 0x140000000 (rva = va - 0x140000000). origin 'mecmp' entries are read from mecmp's source ; on 2026-11-12 every slot, code and typeinfo entry (24) matched our build (verified: true). Function, global and vtable entries got only a weak check (inside the image) and stay unverified; check them with tools/client/verify_dll_addresses.py. origin 'mec-ap' entries are this kit's own, verified in game (docs/MEMORY.md). See docs/DLL.md.
